outcome: physiological responses (heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation)
cohort: A total of 214 American Society of Anaesthesiologists (ASA) physical status II pregnant women scheduled for elective Lower Segment Caesarean Section (LSCS) were included.
finding: Preoperative counselling significantly improved pain tolerance, cooperation, and behaviour, leading to reduced fear and anxiety, better haemodynamic control, and higher overall patient satisfaction during the perioperative period for women undergoing LSCS.
